notes: S2/F61-1 (security; §9.4 case 2): the same container as declaration-compromised-rescued, but the only receipt carries one byte after its TimeStampResp (check 1, E_TS_SCHEMA). Receipts are present and none is verified, trusted and usable, so the declaration's self-signature by the compromised key is unverifiable E_TS_UNTRUSTED (sigs state unverified, §14.6): a receipt that fails cannot rescue a declaration any more than any other record the key signed.
